# Pacific Floors and Coatings

> Epoxy flooring and concrete coating contractor based in Surrey, British Columbia, serving homeowners, businesses, and industrial clients across Metro Vancouver.

- Address: 7304 138 Street, Surrey, BC V3W 5H2, Canada
- Phone: (236) 878-3386
- Email: pacificfloorsandcoatings@gmail.com
- Service area: Surrey, Burnaby, Richmond, Coquitlam, Langley, Delta, White Rock, New Westminster, Maple Ridge, Abbotsford
- Every install starts with dust-extracted diamond grinding, slab repair, and a free on-site estimate.
